decisions.title: Invoice Data Model and TimeLog Linking
decisions.summary: Add an Invoice entity with status (Draft, Sent, Paid), linked to TimeLogs via `invoiceId` on TimeLog and `timeLogIds` on Invoice. When an invoice is generated, update TimeLogs to set `invoiceId` (marking them as billed).

decisions.title: Pending Invoices Definition for Dashboard Widget
decisions.summary: "Pending Invoices" = invoices with status Draft or Sent (i.e., not yet Paid). Widget shows count and total amount of pending invoices.

rules.rule: Invoice status must be one of exactly three values: 'Draft', 'Sent', 'Paid'.
When creating an invoice, both the Invoice creation and TimeLog updates must happen in a single atomic reducer action (GENERATE_INVOICE).
Once an invoice is created, `totalAmount` must not be recalculated. It represents the amount at the time of invoice creation.
When finding unbilled time logs, filter by `!timeLog.invoiceId` (undefined or null).
Invoice IDs should use UUID format but can optionally have an 'inv-' prefix for readability.
"Pending invoices" = invoices where status is 'Draft' OR 'Sent'.
All invoice-related components must be placed in `src/components/Invoices/`.
Invoice components must follow naming convention: `InvoiceList.tsx`, `InvoiceCard.tsx`, `CreateInvoiceModal.tsx`.
Invoice status should be displayed with appropriate visual indicators: Draft: Gray/neutral styling, Sent: Blue/warning styling, Paid: Green/success styling.

warnings.message: Client deletion must cascade to invoices; project deletion leaves invoice totalAmount unchanged (orphaned timeLogIds filtered on display).
